guide.pointportals.appearance: This guide and its first-join hint are new. Use Oval orientation below to follow the viewer or fix the oval east–west. Your choice is saved.
guide.pointportals.hint: Press %s to open the portal guide.
guide.pointportals.hint_unbound: Assign a key to the portal guide in Options → Controls.
guide.pointportals.maps: Use a filled map on a pad to mark it. Map both ends, then sneak and use the map while looking into the air to see the pair. Copies share markers. Locked maps keep a snapshot.
guide.pointportals.pairing: Place two unlinked pads, even in different dimensions. Use the Phase Tuner on the first pad, then on the second. Each pad can have only one twin.
guide.pointportals.power: Power the departure pad with Redstone and step onto it. Leave two blocks clear above the destination. To return, power the other pad, step off and let the cooldown expire.
guide.pointportals.unlinking: Sneak and use an empty Phase Tuner on either pad. If the tuner holds a selection, the first use clears it.
message.pointportals.already_linked: This portal is already linked to another destination.
message.pointportals.cannot_self_link: Cannot link a portal to itself!
message.pointportals.first_portal_select: First portal captured at [%s, %s, %s]. Select the target portal.
message.pointportals.label_invalid: Use a single line of up to %s characters.
message.pointportals.portals_linked: Portals successfully paired! Power with Redstone to activate.
message.pointportals.source_portal_missi: The first portal could not be found or was broken!
message.pointportals.status_standby: Teleporter paired with %s at [%s, %s, %s] (Standby - requires Redstone).
message.pointportals.status_unlinked: Teleporter is unlinked. Use a Phase Tuner to pair.
tooltip.pointportals.tuner_unbound: Right-click an unlinked Teleporter to begin pairing.
